symbols.name: KrnDataGridDataSource
symbols.description:
Latest-query-wins adapter for the Data Grid controlled mode.

The adapter deliberately owns request state, not transport policy: consumers can use fetch,
GraphQL, RPC, or a repository in the loader. Aborted requests never overwrite newer data.

symbols.name: KrnDataGridVirtualMode
symbols.description:
Fixed-height virtualization supports the same selection, sorting, filtering, and resize
contracts as the client grid. Row expansion is intentionally unsupported and is enforced at
runtime because `expandable` is a separate component input.

symbols.name: createKrnOptions
symbols.type: <T extends object>(description: string, defaults: T) => readonly [InjectionToken<Readonly<T>>, (patch: (() => Partial<T>) | Partial<T>) => FactoryProvider]
symbols.description:
Creates a hierarchical immutable options contract.

Defaults, inherited provider values, and provider patches must be plain
records at runtime: objects with the ordinary `Object.prototype` (including
cross-realm objects) or a null prototype. Arrays, functions, class instances,
and built-in collection or asynchronous objects are rejected rather than
silently losing their type. Only enumerable own data properties are accepted;
non-enumerable properties and accessors, including symbol properties, are
rejected without invoking getters.

Providers merge their defined properties over the nearest parent scope.
Component instance inputs can then apply their own final overrides without
mutating the shared provider value.

Immutability is deliberately shallow and top-level: each resolved record is
cloned and frozen, while nested values retain their original identities and
must be treated as immutable by their owners.

symbols.description: Application-replaceable clipboard writer used by KERN copy affordances.

symbols.name: KRN_PLATFORM
symbols.description: Replaceable platform boundary used by all new low-level Kern services.

symbols.name: KrnClipboardWriter
symbols.description:
Replaceable boundary for writing plain text to the system clipboard.

The default writer prefers the asynchronous Clipboard API and only uses the
Angular CDK fallback when that modern API is absent. Consumers can replace
this token in tests or constrained rendering environments.

symbols.name: KrnContent
symbols.description:
Content accepted by composable Kern APIs.

Components should narrow this union deliberately and document which context
is passed to templates. Plain strings remain the preferred accessible default.

symbols.name: KrnIdService
symbols.description:
Application-scoped, SSR-safe ID generation.

`next` is appropriate when server and client instantiate the same view tree
in the same order. `fromKey` is order-independent and should be preferred for
data-driven content with a stable application key.

symbols.name: KrnItemContentContext
symbols.description: Standard template context for item-based components such as Select or Grid.

symbols.name: KrnOverlayCoordinator
symbols.description:
Coordinates modal surfaces rendered in the application tree.

The coordinator deliberately owns global side effects so that nested dialogs
share one scroll lock, only the top surface receives Escape, and background
content is restored to its exact previous state.

symbols.name: KrnOverlayHostResolver
symbols.description: Resolves the element where application-level overlay portals are attached.

symbols.name: KrnPlatformAdapter
symbols.description:
The browser capabilities Kern uses at runtime.

Components should inject this contract instead of reading global `window`,
`document`, storage, or media-query APIs directly. Tests and non-browser
renderers can replace it through `provideKern`.

symbols.name: krnPrefersReducedMotion
symbols.description:
Resolves Kern's effective motion preference.

The explicit application preference wins over the operating-system media
query. Server renderers return `true` so animation-dependent teardown never
delays deterministic rendering.

symbols.name: applyKrnPrepaintTheme
symbols.description:
Applies validated theme preferences before Angular starts.

The helper only mutates attributes and custom properties on an existing
document. It never creates inline scripts, uses `eval`, or writes HTML, so it
can be called from a CSP-approved external module before `bootstrapApplication`.

symbols.name: createKrnTranslations
symbols.description:
Creates an immutable, complete translation set from a typed partial
override. When a patch overrides a legacy template without its corresponding
typed formatter, the resulting complete dictionary derives a safe formatter
from that template instead of retaining the unrelated English formatter.

symbols.name: generateKrnBrandPalette
symbols.description:
Builds a perceptually even OKLCH palette from a hex brand color.
It is deterministic and browser-independent, so it is safe during SSR.

symbols.description:
Kern's public token contract.

The values are CSS custom-property references on purpose: application code can
share the exact same semantic vocabulary as component styles without copying
theme values into JavaScript bundles.

symbols.description:
Replaceable application-wide UI copy. Component-level label inputs remain
available for one-off overrides.

interpolates only exact `{token}` entries from a legacy string template.

Interpolation is single-pass: replacement values are text, are never
evaluated, and cannot introduce a second placeholder expansion.

symbols.name: parseHexColor
symbols.description: Parses #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB and #RRGGBBAA without touching browser APIs.

symbols.name: provideKrn
symbols.description:
Registers Kern's cross-cutting configuration as one environment provider.
Feature-level providers may still override individual tokens in a child
injector when an embedded application needs a different locale or direction.
A child that provides the complete `KRN_TRANSLATIONS` registry directly must
also install `provideKrnTranslationBridge()` so dependency-light leaf-copy
tokens follow that registry.

symbols.name: provideKrnTranslationBridge
symbols.description:
Bridges the complete translation registry to the aggregate set of
tree-shakable leaf-copy tokens.

`provideKrn` installs this automatically. Add it explicitly at a nested
injector boundary that provides `KRN_TRANSLATIONS` directly. The returned
provider array is intentionally extensible as new leaf-copy tokens appear.

symbols.name: KRN_COPY_LABELS
symbols.description:
Lightweight application-wide labels for copy actions.

`provideKrn({translations})` derives this value from the complete Core
translation registry. Consumers that create a nested low-level translation
boundary must install `provideKrnTranslationBridge()` or override this token
directly.

symbols.name: KRN_DEFAULT_COPY_LABELS
symbols.description: English fallback used when an application does not configure copy labels.

symbols.name: KRN_DEFAULT_LOADING_LABEL
symbols.description: English fallback used when an application does not configure loading copy.

symbols.name: KRN_DEFAULT_MORE_ACTIONS_LABEL
symbols.description: Default accessible name for a menu segment that reveals related actions.

symbols.name: KRN_LOADING_LABEL
symbols.description:
Lightweight application-wide loading copy.

`provideKrn({translations})` derives this token from
`translations.feedback.loadingInProgress`. Consumers that create a nested
locale boundary with low-level tokens must also install
`provideKrnTranslationBridge()` from Core, or override this leaf token
directly.

symbols.name: KRN_MORE_ACTIONS_LABEL
symbols.description:
Tree-shakable accessible copy for menu-button segments.

`provideKrn` bridges this token to `translations.actions.moreActions`.
Leaf consumers can override it directly without retaining the complete
translation registry.

symbols.name: KrnCopyLabels
symbols.description:
Small, immutable copy contract for leaf components that must not retain the
complete Core translation registry.

symbols.name: KRN_BUTTON_GROUP_OPTIONS
symbols.description:
Scoped button-group defaults. Each provider merges a partial immutable patch
with the closest ancestor configuration.

symbols.name: KRN_BUTTON_OPTIONS
symbols.description:
Scoped button defaults. Provide a partial patch at any injector boundary;
descendants inherit the closest merged, immutable value.

symbols.name: KRN_COPY_BUTTON_OPTIONS
symbols.description:
Scoped Copy Button defaults. Each provider merges a partial immutable patch
with the closest ancestor configuration.

symbols.name: KRN_FLOATING_ACTION_BUTTON_OPTIONS
symbols.description:
Scoped floating-action defaults. Each provider supplies a partial immutable
patch that is merged with the closest ancestor configuration.

symbols.name: KRN_ICON_BUTTON_OPTIONS
symbols.description:
Scoped icon-button defaults. Each provider supplies a partial immutable
patch that is merged with the closest ancestor configuration.

symbols.name: KRN_MENU_BUTTON_OPTIONS
symbols.description:
Scoped defaults shared by Dropdown Button and Split Button.

Each provider merges a partial immutable patch with the closest ancestor
configuration.

symbols.name: KRN_TOGGLE_BUTTON_OPTIONS
symbols.description:
Scoped Toggle Button defaults. Each provider supplies a partial immutable
patch that is merged with the closest ancestor configuration.

symbols.name: KRN_TOGGLE_GROUP_OPTIONS
symbols.description:
Scoped Toggle Group defaults. Each provider merges an immutable partial
patch with the closest ancestor configuration.

symbols.name: KrnButtonGroupOptions
symbols.description:
Inheritable layout defaults for `KrnButtonGroup`.

Accessible naming, focus, activation, loading, disabled, and form semantics
intentionally remain native concerns of the group host and its child actions.

symbols.name: KrnButtonOptions
symbols.description:
Inheritable defaults for `KrnButton`.

Native button semantics such as `type`, `disabled`, `name`, `value`, and
form ownership intentionally stay on the host element and are never
configured through this options contract.

symbols.name: KrnCopyButtonOptions
symbols.description:
Inheritable appearance and feedback defaults for `KrnCopyButton`.

Clipboard values, accessible labels, disabled state, and outputs remain
instance concerns and are intentionally excluded from this contract.

symbols.name: KrnCopyState
symbols.description:
Settled visual feedback exposed by `KrnCopyButton`.

Pending work intentionally remains a separate boolean so this published
union stays backward compatible.

symbols.name: krnCssLength
symbols.type: (value: KrnLayoutSpace | null | undefined, fallback?: string) => string

symbols.name: KrnEditableComboboxBase
symbols.description: Base contract for editable KERN combobox implementations.

symbols.name: KrnFloatingActionButtonOptions
symbols.description:
Inheritable visual and loading-copy defaults for `KrnFloatingActionButton`.

Native button semantics such as `type`, `disabled`, form ownership, and
accessible-name relationships intentionally remain on the host element.

symbols.name: KrnIconButtonOptions
symbols.description:
Inheritable visual and loading-copy defaults for `KrnIconButton`.

Native button semantics such as `type`, `disabled`, form ownership, and
accessible-name attributes intentionally remain on the host element.

symbols.name: KrnLink
symbols.description:
Applies KERN link presentation to a native navigation anchor.

The browser or Angular Router owns the destination, browsing context,
relationship tokens, accessibility relationships, focus, and activation.
Use a native button component for actions that do not navigate.

symbols.name: KrnMenuButtonOptions
symbols.description:
Inheritable appearance and positioning defaults for menu-button components.

Menu content, controlled open state, disabled/loading state and selection
behavior remain instance concerns.

symbols.name: KrnMenuTrigger
symbols.description: Identifies projected trigger content without a parallel boolean input.

symbols.name: KrnOptionsState
symbols.description:
Loading contract for option-backed controls.

`ready` includes both populated and genuinely empty results. Consumers keep
the previous options out of the interaction model while a request is loading
or has failed, avoiding accidental selection of stale data.

symbols.name: KrnToggleButtonOptions
KrnToggleGroupOptions
symbols.description:
Inheritable interaction defaults for `KrnToggleGroup`.

Controlled values and disabled state intentionally remain instance state:
application defaults must not silently select or disable a toolbar.

symbols.name: KrnTreeChildrenState
symbols.description:
State of a branch whose children are supplied asynchronously.

Omit the state for a leaf or a branch whose `children` are already the
complete source of truth. Use `idle` before the first request, `loading`
while a request is in flight, and `error` to expose a retryable failure.

symbols.name: KrnUploadBase
symbols.description: Base contract for custom KERN upload controls.

symbols.name: KrnValueAccessor
symbols.description: Base ControlValueAccessor and Validator contract for custom KERN form controls.

symbols.name: KrnButtonGroupHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for the canonical `div[krnButtonGroup]` host and its legacy element alias.

Button Group is a stateless semantic and layout container. Selection belongs
to Toggle Group or Segmented Control, so this harness intentionally exposes
no value, pressed, or selection API.

symbols.name: KrnButtonHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for the native `button[krnButton]` host.

Consumers should prefer this API over querying KERN's internal DOM or CSS classes.

symbols.name: KrnCalendarCellHarness
symbols.description: Harness for a calendar grid cell.

symbols.name: KrnChartDatumHarness
symbols.description: Harness for an interactive line point, bar, or donut legend entry.

symbols.name: KrnChartHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for `krn-chart`.

The same consumer-facing methods are available on the typed line, bar, and
donut wrapper harnesses below.

symbols.name: KrnChartTableRowHarness
symbols.description: Harness for a row in the optional accessible chart data table.

symbols.name: KrnColorPresetHarness
symbols.description: Harness for a color preset exposed inside `krn-color-picker`.

symbols.name: KrnCommandPaletteHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for `krn-command-palette`.

Opening the palette remains an application concern because the component has
no visual trigger of its own. Once open, this harness owns all palette
interactions.

symbols.name: KrnCommandPaletteOptionHarness
symbols.description: Harness for a command-palette result option.

symbols.name: KrnCopyButtonHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for `krn-copy-button`.

State and appearance are read from the custom-element host while focus and
activation are delegated to its inner native button.

symbols.name: KrnDataGridHarness
symbols.description: Harness for both `krn-data-grid` and its `krn-data-table` alias.

symbols.name: KrnDropdownButtonHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for `krn-dropdown-button` and its connected ARIA menu.

The trigger lives under the component host while the menu is rendered in a
document-level CDK overlay, so menu lookup follows the public
`aria-controls` relationship instead of relying on overlay DOM order.

symbols.name: KrnDropUploadHarness
symbols.description: Harness for `krn-drop-upload` and its documented alias.

symbols.name: KrnEditableComboboxHarness
symbols.description: Shared harness contract for editable comboboxes.

symbols.name: KrnFloatingActionButtonHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for the native `button[krnFab]` host.

The projected label remains queryable in compact mode because visual collapse
must not remove the native button's accessible name.

symbols.name: KrnFormControlHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for KERN's native text-like controls.

It covers text, password, search and number inputs as well as textareas while
preserving a single interaction contract for consumer tests.

symbols.name: KrnFormFieldHarness
symbols.description: Harness for `krn-form-field`, including projected controls and descriptions.

symbols.name: KrnIconButtonHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for the native `button[krnIconButton]` host.

It intentionally exposes native button state instead of relying on KERN's internal icon DOM.

symbols.name: KrnLinkHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for the native `a[krnLink]` host.

Consumers should prefer this API over querying KERN presentation classes.

symbols.name: KrnOverlayHarness
symbols.description: Shared test contract for KERN's modal surfaces.

symbols.name: KrnPickerHarness
symbols.description: Shared harness contract for popup date and time controls.

symbols.name: KrnResizablePanelsHarness
symbols.description: Harness for `krn-resizable-panels` and its panels and separator handles.

symbols.name: KrnSplitButtonHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for both native action segments of `krn-split-button` and its connected ARIA menu.

Overlay lookup follows the menu trigger's public `aria-controls` relationship, so tests do not
depend on CDK overlay DOM order.

symbols.name: KrnToggleButtonHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for the native `button[krnToggleButton]` host.

It exposes the effective standalone or group-owned pressed state without
coupling tests to KERN's projected label DOM.

symbols.name: KrnToggleGroupHarness
symbols.description:
Harness for the canonical `div[krnToggleGroup]` toolbar and its legacy element alias.

It exposes effective pressed values and direct native toggle children without
coupling tests to the private item-registration or roving-focus implementation.

symbols.name: KrnTreeItemHarness
symbols.description: Harness for tree and tree-navigation items.

symbols.name: KrnUploadHarness
symbols.description: Shared harness contract for file upload controls.

recipes.title: Install KERN in an Angular application
recipes.summary: Register the required global stylesheet and optionally configure application-wide preferences.
steps: Run ng add @kern-ui/angular --project <application>.
Keep @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css loaded exactly once.
Use provideKrn only when the application owns theme, locale, direction, translations or overlay-host configuration.
Run the KERN doctor in strict mode in CI.

recipes.title: Choose Select, Combobox, Autocomplete or Tags Input
recipes.summary: Select by value authority and cardinality before choosing visual treatment.
steps: Use Select or Native Select for one value from a known set.
Use Multi Select for several values from a bounded known set.
Use Combobox when users search but must commit a known option.
Use Autocomplete when suggestions help but unmatched free text remains valid.
Use Tags Input for user-authored multiple values.

recipes.title: Build a typed reactive form
recipes.summary: Compose Form Field and KERN value accessors with Angular typed reactive forms.
steps: Import ReactiveFormsModule and the narrow KERN component symbols.
Keep visible labels and specific validation messages in Form Field.
Let Angular validators and the KERN value accessor share disabled, required and invalid state.

recipes.title: Use Data Grid with server-owned data
recipes.summary: Keep query state controlled while preserving stable row and column identity.
steps: Use mode.kind controlled and pass the server totalRows.
Return an immutable domain key from rowIdentity.
Handle queryChange and request the next server slice.
Keep sort and filter state visible while loading.

recipes.title: Compose nested overlays safely
recipes.summary: Preserve focus, Escape ordering and modal ownership when popups open inside a dialog.
steps: Use KERN overlay components for built-in ownership registration.
Let the inner popup consume Escape before the containing modal.
Project only non-interactive label content into Popover, Hover Card, or Menu trigger slots; each component owns the outer button semantics.
When using a custom CDK primitive, register trigger-to-pane ownership with KrnOverlayCoordinator.
Keep the original trigger mounted for focus restoration.

recipes.title: Use KERN with SSR and hydration
recipes.summary: Keep server and client configuration, locale, dates, ids and overlay host deterministic.
steps: Load the same CSS and provideKrn configuration on server and client.
Use stable domain keys for data-driven ids.
Provide deterministic today values to date surfaces when clocks may differ.
Render a dedicated overlay host consistently or rely on the body fallback.
Validate the consuming route; the documentation SSR build is integration evidence, not a universal guarantee.

recipes.title: Model dates, time, instants and time zones
recipes.summary: Keep date-only and time-of-day values separate from zoned instants until the application boundary.
steps: Use date-only values for Calendar and Date Picker, not midnight JavaScript Date instances.
Use Time Picker for a time of day and store the intended zone separately.
Convert to an instant only where the product has an explicit time-zone policy.
Provide deterministic today values during SSR, hydration and tests.

recipes.title: Keep Tree identity and asynchronous children deterministic
recipes.summary: Treat node identifiers and expanded state as domain contracts while loading immutable child branches explicitly.
steps: Use non-empty unique domain identifiers that survive immutable updates.
Control expanded identifiers when routing or persistence owns the state.
Represent loading, empty and failed child states explicitly.
Use Tree Navigation for destinations and Tree for hierarchical data interaction.

recipes.title: Load Combobox options from a remote source
recipes.summary: Keep query and request state controlled while preventing stale or failed options from being selected.
steps: Disable the built-in local filter for server-ranked results.
Handle queryChange with a cancellable latest-query-wins request.
Drive optionsState through ready, loading and error.
Keep committed values separate from the current search query.

recipes.title: Build accessible analytics with Charts
recipes.summary: Choose stable datum identity, bound interactive marks and keep the exact source-data table available.
steps: Use finite values, non-empty labels and unique stable datum ids.
Choose clamp or reject as an explicit negative-value policy.
Aggregate large series before rendering interactive SVG marks.
Keep the source-data table and do not encode meaning by color alone.
recipes.code:
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component } from '@angular/core'; import { bootstrapApplication } from '@angular/platform-browser'; import { KrnBarChart, KrnDonutChart, KrnLineChart, type KrnChartDatum, type KrnChartDatumIdentity, } from '@kern-ui/angular/addon-charts'; @Component({ selector: 'app-kern-accessible-analytics-recipe', standalone: true, imports: [KrnBarChart, KrnDonutChart, KrnLineChart], changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, template: ` @for (datum of revenue; track datum.id) { }
Exact quarterly recurring revenue
Quarter Revenue
{{ datum.label }} {{ datum.value }}
`, }) export class KernAccessibleAnalyticsRecipe { readonly datumIdentity: KrnChartDatumIdentity = (datum) => datum.id ?? datum.label; readonly revenue: readonly KrnChartDatum[] = [ { id: '2026-q1', label: 'Q1', value: 4.2 }, { id: '2026-q2', label: 'Q2', value: 5.7 }, { id: '2026-q3', label: 'Q3', value: 6.1 }, ]; readonly risk: readonly KrnChartDatum[] = [ { id: 'platform', label: 'Platform', value: 18 }, { id: 'security', label: 'Security', value: 31 }, ]; readonly plans: readonly KrnChartDatum[] = [ { id: 'team', label: 'Team', value: 420 }, { id: 'enterprise', label: 'Enterprise', value: 180 }, ]; } void bootstrapApplication(KernAccessibleAnalyticsRecipe);

recipes.title: Install the complete Russian locale pack
recipes.summary: Configure locale, direction and shared component translations through one schema-checked pack.
steps: Adapt KRN_RU_RU_LOCALE with krnLocaleConfig.
Pass the result to provideKrn at the application boundary.
Keep product copy in the application and use typed overrides only for shared component UI.
Use the same locale configuration during SSR and hydration.

recipes.title: Test through public component harnesses
recipes.summary: Keep application tests independent of KERN's internal DOM and CSS classes.
steps: Import harnesses only from @kern-ui/angular/testing.
Use filters to locate controls by stable user-facing labels.
Assert domain behavior in the application and interaction mechanics through harness methods.
Retain one browser integration path for focus, SSR/hydration and accessibility.

recipes.title: Generate typed forms, grids and CRUD features
recipes.summary: Start common enterprise screens from strict, canonical KERN imports and explicit state ownership.
steps: Generate a typed-form, data-grid or crud feature for the owning Angular project.
Choose client, controlled or virtual Grid mode explicitly.
Adapt domain fields and transport while retaining stable identity.
Run doctor --strict --json after generation.

migrations.summary: Move root compatibility imports to the canonical cdk, i18n, core, kit, addon-grid, addon-charts, patterns, or testing owner.
migrations.after:
import { KrnButton } from '@kern-ui/angular/kit';
import { KrnDataGrid } from '@kern-ui/angular/addon-grid';

migrations.to: KrnSwitch.checkedChange with checked/checkedChange two-way binding, or Angular Forms
migrations.summary: Name Switch state after the native checked property. Use checkedChange for standalone state, or keep formControl/ngModel as the single owner when Angular Forms is present.

migrations.to: <button krnButton>, (click), native ARIA attributes other than loading-owned aria-disabled, or KrnToggleButton
migrations.summary: Move Button behavior onto the native button, replace static ariaLabel with aria-label and bound ariaLabel with attr.aria-label, and replace pressed with KrnToggleButton unless native aria-pressed semantics are intentional. aria-disabled is reserved for the derived loading state; use native disabled for ordinary unavailability.

migrations.to: <a krnLink> with native anchor/ARIA attributes, href or RouterLink, and (click)
migrations.summary: Move Link presentation onto one native anchor. Keep href or RouterLink, arbitrary named targets, rel, download, referrerpolicy, accessible-name relationships, and click on that host. KrnLink no longer rewrites rel or simulates disabled navigation; render unavailable navigation as text or omit it.

migrations.to: KrnToggleButton harness semantics or the native aria-pressed attribute
migrations.summary: Use KrnToggleButton for toggle interactions. If a plain native button deliberately owns aria-pressed, remove the pressed harness filter and read getNativeButton().getAttribute('aria-pressed') explicitly.
migrations.before:
const button = await loader.getHarness(KrnButtonHarness.with({ pressed: true }));
expect(await button.isPressed()).toBe(true);

migrations.from: <krn-icon-button>, (activated), ariaLabel, pressed, disabled, and type inputs
migrations.to: <button krnIconButton> for actions or KrnToggleButton for pressed state
migrations.summary: Move stateless Icon Button behavior onto the native button, replace static ariaLabel with aria-label and bound ariaLabel with attr.aria-label, and keep type, disabled, form, accessible naming, descriptions, and click semantics on the host. aria-disabled is reserved for loading; use native disabled for ordinary unavailability. Migrate pressed state to KrnToggleButton so the visual and accessibility states remain synchronized.
migrations.after:
<!-- Stateless action -->
<button
  krnIconButton
  [attr.aria-label]="actionLabel"
  [disabled]="saving"
  type="submit"
  (click)="save()"
>✓</button>

<!-- Managed pressed state -->
<button
  krnToggleButton
  value="selected"
  [(pressed)]="selected"
  [disabled]="saving"
>Selected</button>

migrations.to: <button krnFab>, (click), native button/form semantics, and native ARIA attributes other than loading-owned aria-disabled
migrations.summary: Move Floating Action Button behavior onto one native button, keep the projected label mounted as its accessible name in compact mode, and preserve loading focus while duplicate activation is suppressed. aria-disabled is reserved for loading; use native disabled for ordinary unavailability.

Move managed pressed state onto one native button. Keep value, disabled, pressed, native form attributes, accessible-name relationships, and click on that host; aria-pressed is derived and owned by KrnToggleButton.

migrations.to: <div krnToggleGroup> and native aria-label or aria-labelledby attributes
migrations.summary: Move Toggle Group coordination onto the canonical labelled toolbar host. The legacy element and ariaLabel input remain deprecated compatibility bridges; direct native Toggle Button children participate in roving focus and controlled values.

migrations.to: <div krnButtonGroup> and native aria-label or aria-labelledby attributes
migrations.summary: Move Button Group layout onto the canonical directive host and keep accessible naming on the native element. The legacy element and ariaLabel input remain deprecated compatibility bridges; orientation and connected affect layout only.

migrations.from: A nested injector that provides KRN_TRANSLATIONS directly for KrnCopyButton
migrations.to: The same KRN_TRANSLATIONS provider plus provideKrnTranslationBridge(), or a direct KRN_COPY_LABELS override
migrations.summary: Keep Copy Button in a tree-shakable i18n entrypoint while explicitly bridging a nested complete translation registry. Application-wide provideKrn() already installs the bridge and needs no change.
migrations.after:
providers: [
  { provide: KRN_TRANSLATIONS, useValue: nestedTranslations },
  provideKrnTranslationBridge(),
]

migrations.from: KrnFormField id, required, disabled, readonly, and state inputs
migrations.to: The projected control id/native state and its Angular FormControl status
migrations.summary: Keep Form Field as a label, layout, and description coordinator. Move control identity and required/readonly state to the projected control, disable reactive controls through FormControl.disable(), and represent invalid/pending/valid through the real Angular control or mounted error content.
migrations.after:
<krn-form-field
  label="Workspace name"
  [error]="visibleError"
>
  <krn-text-input
    id="workspace-name"
    required
    [readonly]="locked"
    [formControl]="control"
  />
</krn-form-field>

// Disable the Angular model and native control together.
if (saving) control.disable();
else control.enable();

migrations.summary: Replace the compatibility pagination input with an explicit client-mode object.
Replace the compatibility virtualize input with the discriminated virtual-mode object.
Apply the explicit trigger directive to projected menu trigger content.
